Container.Name: jack
Container.Overview: jack lets you and your friends share your Radarr/Sonarr libraries with each other. It adds itself to your Radarr and Sonarr as an indexer and a download client, and downloads files straight from your friends' jacks. This is the server; install jack-ui next to it for the web interface. Setup guide: https://github.com/LeetDonkey/jack/blob/main/website/guide/unraid.md
Container.Requires: A Docker network named "jack" (Unraid terminal: docker network create jack). Radarr and/or Sonarr.

Config.Name: Port for Radarr/Sonarr and friends
Config.Description: Your Radarr/Sonarr reach jack on this port, and your reverse proxy sends friends' jacks here. Don't forward it on your router: friends come in through a reverse proxy with HTTPS.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: config.jsonc, the database and logs. jack creates a default config here on first start.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Your movie share, e.g. /mnt/user/media/movies: click the field to pick it. Then click Edit and set the Container Path to EXACTLY the path your Radarr container uses for this folder (its root folder, e.g. /movies or /data/media/movies). Read-only. Leave it empty if you don't share movies.

Config.Name: TV
Config.Description: Your TV share, e.g. /mnt/user/media/tv: click the field to pick it. Then click Edit and set the Container Path to EXACTLY the path your Sonarr container uses for this folder (its root folder, e.g. /tv or /data/media/tv). Read-only. Leave it empty if you don't share TV.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: A folder inside the share your Radarr/Sonarr use for downloads, e.g. /mnt/user/downloads/jack: pick the share, then add /jack. jack puts finished downloads here for Radarr/Sonarr to import. Keep the Container Path /data/jack: Radarr and Sonarr must see this folder at /data/jack too. If they map that share to /data, they already do. Otherwise add a path with this Host Path and the Container Path /data/jack to the Radarr and Sonarr templates.

Config.Name: Internal URL
Config.Description: http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:5225 (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5225), the address Radarr/Sonarr use to reach jack. Only read when jack creates its config on first start; change it later in jack-ui under Settings -> Radarr & Sonarr -> Address Radarr/Sonarr use to reach jack.

Config.Name: Management key
Config.Description: A long random secret that jack-ui uses to talk to jack. jack doesn't start without it. Generate one in the Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -hex 32. Use the same value in jack-ui, and keep a copy: Unraid hides it here.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: How much jack writes to its log. Keep info unless someone helping you asks for debug.
